purpose: Record the fail-closed local implementation of the L9 operator-action receipt verifier without claiming or executing an offline production-copy rehearsal, production install, canary, packet gate, product completion, or shared-goal completion.

Gate/audit dispatcher and aggregate create-only L9 execution receipt builder.
Generic receipt validation with same-authority multi-packet checkpoint support.
L9 positive, negative, runner, schema, and future checkpoint compatibility regression coverage.

corrected_defects: Gate mode without --lane can no longer return a successful audit result.
The exact planned L9 invocation can no longer pass without an explicit immutable promotion manifest.
Selecting L9-REALM-PROMOTION cannot recursively invoke the same runner.
L9 now requires three separate hash-bound operator-action receipts for offline rehearsal, default-off install, and production canary.
Approval receipts bind exact hashed scope, root, ports, principals, workspace, argv, forbidden scope, preconditions, expiry, rollback, release candidate, realm fingerprint, and deployment generation.
The verifier requires an accepted XG-SBE-TARGET-OPERATIONS-HANDOFF receipt and current AGENTS.md, goal-observation, and schema-lineage bindings.
The same release candidate, artifact manifest, derivation proof, and deployment generation must span rehearsal, install, and canary; any rebuild attestation fails.
The install receipt requires port 10012, default-off state, zero user enablement, gateway package/restart/health, configuration derivation, before/after hashes, and rollback readiness.

The canary receipt requires exactly two collaborator identities and one outsider negative control, telemetry soak, abort thresholds, aggregate and capability kill-switch exercises, rollback/recovery, and zero loss, post-revoke delivery, or convergence mismatch.
A multi-packet L9 aggregate receipt is accepted across later R0A/R0B/R1 checkpoints only when all historical authority bindings are identical; drift remains fail-closed.

redundant_full_harness_attempt.reason: The suite repeatedly recomputed the already preserved V0 image and receipt bundle. One early stale summary assertion expected 43/18/14 while the integrated central state is 44/21/15; no new L9 failure was observed before termination.

remaining_gate_requirements: O1B-P1 requires the missing approved external encrypted destination, key custody, retention authority, target Windows host, and sealed target restore runner; its target gate remains blocked.
Q0-P1 requires an actual sealed target_windows_load run and immutable target report at all frozen denominators; local synthetic results are not a substitute.
R0A-P1 requires a current XG-SBE-TARGET-OPERATIONS-HANDOFF and exact AP-PROD-REHEARSAL before any approved offline production-copy action.
R0B-P1 requires exact AP-PROD-DEPLOY before the frozen generation may be installed default-off at 10012 or owned services restarted.
R1-P1 requires exact AP-PROD-CANARY naming the two collaborators, outsider, workspace, duration, abort thresholds, kill switches, and rollback scope.
The three real operator actions must emit create-only receipts and a create-only promotion manifest satisfying this verifier; no such production receipt is claimed here.
L9-FULL-PYTHON-SUITE, all six Node lanes, L9-REALM-PROMOTION, all remaining packet/matrix/phase gates, and the strict Z0 audit must pass on the frozen release before completion.
